name: web-to-elementor
description: Batch-replicate user-supplied web pages into hand-editable Elementor pages with localized media and built-in three-device responsiveness.

displayDescription.en: Batch-replicate web pages into hand-editable Elementor pages, localize images into the media library, and ship desktop/tablet/mobile responsive layouts in one pass.
displayDescription.zh: 把网页批量复刻成可手编的 Elementor 页面，图片入媒体库，一次做好电脑平板手机三端响应式。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我把几个网页的 HTML 文件直接发给你（存在我自己的任意目录），复刻成 testdecor 里可手工编辑的 Elementor 页面，图片传媒体库，直接做好三端响应式
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'll send you several web page HTML files straight from my own folders. Replicate them into hand-editable Elementor pages on testdecor, upload images to the media library, and make them responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile in one pass.

quickPrompts.en: I'll send you several web page HTML files straight from my own folders. Replicate them into hand-editable Elementor pages on testdecor, upload images to the media library, and make them responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile in one pass.
quickPrompts.zh: 我把几个网页的 HTML 文件直接发给你（存在我自己的任意目录），复刻成 testdecor 里可手工编辑的 Elementor 页面，图片传媒体库，直接做好三端响应式

quickPrompts.en: Turn these pages into new WordPress pages, but switch the target site to a new address I'll give you. Same one-pass responsive build.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这几个网页做成新页面，目标站点换成我给你的新地址，同样一次做成响应式

quickPrompts.en: Check the batch of new pages on my site and verify there is no horizontal overflow on mobile, tablet or desktop.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查我后台这批新页面的响应式，确认手机、平板、桌面三端都不横向溢出
